entries.reason: the port carries no class that conforms to it: the content extension is the application's own view controller, and a class that declares the conformance emits the protocol in its own translation unit
entries.effect: not in the backports: NSProtocolFromString("UNNotificationContentExtension") answers nil in a process with no conforming class, and a process with one answers its own
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2; the release runs no extension host at all

entries.reason: it is a message the system sends to the extension's own view controller, and this release's system sends no notification to any extension
entries.effect: nothing in the port calls it; an extension that implements it is never called, and no notification is ever handed to it
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: the same message with the response the user chose, and the same wall: the release draws no notification, offers no action and returns no response
entries.effect: nothing in the port calls it, so its completion handler is never run
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: it is the extension telling its own player to start, through the extension context; the port's -mediaPlayingStarted exists for the other direction and answers as recorded there, and this one is the application's own player being called by the application's own code
entries.effect: nothing in the port calls it; an extension that wires it to its player still works, because the call never passes through the backports
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: the other half of the same pair, for the same reason
entries.effect: nothing in the port calls it
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: it is the extension's own answer about the button it draws; the port draws no button and asks no extension about one
entries.effect: nothing in the port reads it; the protocol itself is not carried, so there is no accessor to call
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: the frame of the button the extension itself places, in the extension's own view; no host ever asks for it and no button is ever placed by the port
entries.effect: nothing in the port reads it
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: the tint of that same button, for the same reason
